event.description: Train the rank-7 position near miss for 50000 steps
event.proposal: family: training control; current retained incumbent is 2739 parameters at 99.7000%, a +0.70 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0049, retraining a rank-9 positional factor with zero weight decay at 2933 parameters and 100.00%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0065, extending a free FF output-tie candidate to 50000 steps at 2816 parameters and 0.02%; prior attempts in this family: 4. Hypothesis: attempt-0075's rank-7 positional candidate reached 97.69% at 2690 parameters after 30000 steps under the now-qualified attention organization, so the near miss may be convergence-limited. Keep the exact rank-7 architecture and change only max_steps from 30000 to 50000, preserving zero weight decay and the same schedule shape; this is more informative than changing learning rate because it isolates optimization time after a measured near miss, while the nearest architectural alternative would confound position capacity with training. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, three shared query rows, shared head-0 output map, ff23, two final group scales, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
